layout.footer: You are receiving this because someone used this address on Bedrock.
layout.fallbackLink: If the button does not work, paste this into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address for {organization}
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Hi {name}, confirm this address to finish setting up your {organization} account. Until you do, you cannot sign in to anything.
verifyEmail.footer: If you did not create this account you can ignore this message.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your {organization} password
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: Hi {name}, choose a new password for your {organization} account. This link can be used once and expires within the hour.
resetPassword.footer: If you did not ask for a new password, ignore this message and nothing changes.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {organization}
invitation.heading: Join {organization}
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to join {organization} as {role, select, owner {an owner} admin {an admin} other {a member}}. Accept the invitation to set up your account and get access.
invitation.footer: If you were not expecting this invitation you can ignore it. It expires on {expiresOn}.
